claims.claim: For n fixed legal sites and B>=2 iid categorical samples, E[m(X)]=1/B+(1-1/B)m(p), hence corrected collision m*=(B m(X)-1)/(B-1) is unbiased for m(p). For adapted selectors pair probability is E[p_t(a_s)] for s<t, not an iid probability product; the correction is a realized collision statistic, not generally an unbiased adaptive concentration estimator.
claims.limit: Finite n,B, fixed legal support, exact iid enumeration n3 B4 two laws; actual adaptive results descriptive, no symmetry-breaking limit.

claims.claim: For fixed legal sites, ordered squared-displacement shell masses of predictable categorical covariance sum to zero, with nonpositive off-diagonal masses and exact distance moment -sum_d d C_d=2 mean_t Var_{p_t}(position). Empirical raw covariance splits into drift, innovation and cross, shellwise and at fixed clocks; compensated time innovations have zero population off-lag covariance without stationarity.
claims.limit: Native finite conditional categorical laws and repeated-root sample covariance; geometric spread not physical xi; finite sample pointwise deviations not universal autocorrelation; same-agent direct methods.

items.scope: Actual normalized occupancy concentration, iid-collision correction, entropy, signed centered modes, five sizes and two density arms; distinguish independent budgets and prefixes; no spontaneous order.
